source.note: The repository is public and pre-release: it has no release tag and nothing is published to a package registry, so every profile is a clone of the repository at the pinned commit. The dependency release tags are the pins in pins.toml; the verified profiles do not need them.

verifier.reason: No profile installs or runs an independent verifier: the verifier belongs to the agent harness, which no tested step installs. A native engine pass or fail is not a verdict.

docker-compose.disabled_reason: The main branch of this repository ships no Compose file, no Dockerfile and no runner service. A Compose packaging exists only as unmerged work and its files have been validated statically, never started; a Compose profile will be offered only when one is merged and run in CI.

kubernetes-helm.disabled_reason: This repository ships no Helm chart and no Kubernetes manifests for the runner, so there is nothing to test; the cluster checks in qa-checks inspect other people's manifests and are not a deployment of this runtime.
